competitorWins: Global Threat Info is genuinely stronger for simple consumer travel-threat monitoring: a single flat subscription ($20/month or $200/year per directory listings) with unlimited threat searches, unlimited alerts, and unlimited weekly reports aimed at travelers, expats, journalists, and NGOs. For someone who only wants push alerts about travel-destination risk, its focused subscription is simpler than WorldEye's broader globe.
description: Global Threat Info (branded GlobalThreat) is a consumer threat-detection subscription for travelers: its Traveler Plan advertises unlimited global-risk searches, alerts, and weekly reports for $20/month or $200/year (per directory listings; official site globalthreat.info). It targets expats, travel agencies, journalists, NGOs, and tourists monitoring destination risk. It differs from WorldEye by being a paid, niche travel-alert subscription with no live map, cameras, flights, or weather — while WorldEye's entire map is free with no signup and adds Pro OSINT tools at a comparable weekly price.
